title: Grok delivers viral vulgar roasts of Musk, Netanyahu and Starmer
summary: xAI’s Grok drew massive attention on X after delivering profanity-filled roasts of Elon Musk, Benjamin Netanyahu and Keir Starmer following user prompts.

title: Florida Senate passes state-level stablecoin bill, awaits DeSantis’ signature
summary: SB 314 expands Florida’s money services law to cover stablecoins, requiring issuer compliance with existing regulations while banning unlicensed issuance.

title: Bitcoin dip may not be over as retail ramps up buying below $70K: Santiment
summary: Bitcoin whales have sold about 66% of the Bitcoin they recently accumulated since Wednesday, according to crypto sentiment platform Santiment.

title: Trump’s National Cyber Strategy pledges to support crypto and blockchain
summary: Mixers, privacy coins and the threat quantum computing could pose to Bitcoin were all points of speculation across the industry following the release of Trump’s Cyber Strategy.

title: Community banks and crypto industry ‘are allies’ in CLARITY Act debate: Exec
summary: If the crypto industry and community banks cannot find common ground on the CLARITY Act, the only winners will be the “big banks,” according to crypto executive Austin Campbell.

title: When buying Bitcoin, don’t expect profit for at least 3 years: Data
summary: Bitcoin’s price volatility tends to scare off buyers, but data shows investors who hold for at least three years have a higher chance of locking in significant returns.

title: Bank of Canada pilot issues country’s first tokenized bond
summary: A pilot involving the central bank and major financial institutions tested whether distributed ledger infrastructure could streamline bond issuance, trading and settlement.

title: Ex-CFO sentenced to two years after diverting $35M to crypto venture
summary: Nevin Shetty was convicted of wire fraud related to secretly moving $35 million in funds from a Seattle startup to his own crypto platform in 2022 to use for DeFi investments.

title: Price predictions 3/6: BTC, ETH, BNB, XRP, SOL, DOGE, ADA, BCH, HYPE, XMR
summary: Bitcoin sold off below $70,000 on Friday, leading analysts to conclude that this week’s breakout to $74,000 was a relief rally rather than a longer-lasting sign of a trend change.

title: Curve Finance accuses PancakeSwap of copying its code
summary: The Curve Finance team told PancakeSwap that it must go through the proper licensing process to collaborate and use code created by Curve.
